description: Propagation steps for a reporting-line change: named workers move to a new manager, with no cost-centre or compensation change. Authored by the HR Ops owner who holds this sequence today; the engineering deliverable is the schema and the orchestrator, not these contents. This graph deliberately has no approval gate — a same-cost-centre manager change is not inside SOX change-management scope. Approval is a per-step policy field, not a hardcoded stage, so a graph that does not need one simply omits it.

steps.label: Reassign workers to the new manager
steps.dependency_reason: none — this is the root step. The new manager (M-201) already exists; unlike a team move, no cost centre has to be created first.

steps.label: Reflect the new reporting line in the org planning tool
steps.dependency_reason: soft — the HR system is the system of record for reporting lines. The plan should reflect reality, not lead it.
steps.manual_reason: no API available in this environment; a human keys the change
steps.instructions: Move each named worker from the source manager's rollup to the destination manager's rollup. Worker IDs are not resolved on a manager_change ChangeSet — match by name against the HR record you just updated, do not guess an ID.
